subject: general
question:
**Select the word which means the same as the group of words given.**

A person who knows everything
solution:
The correct answer is **'Omniscient'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us look into the meaning of the words in the options - 
 
 
• **Omnipresent **- widely or constantly encountered; widespread.
 
• Omniscient - knowing everything.
 
• **Omnipotent** - (of a deity) having unlimited power.
 
• **Omnivorous **- (of an animal or person) feeding on a variety of food of both plant and animal origin.
 
 
 
• From the above meanings, it is clear that **omniscient** is the best word to substitute for the given group of words. 
 
• Hence, **option 2** is the correct answer.
